name: Iris
source:
Calm, shy and insecure, Iris has been an orphan for most of her life. From a young age, she became one of the most important and reliable maids in the city. Now, she lives only to serve her mistress in a world full of pain and torture. Despite all of this, this pretty and kind girl seems to have a secret or two under her sleeves. 

[from official site]
